name: Naïve MLR STLF benchmark
description: A benchmarking reference that evaluates a naïve multiple linear regression baseline for short-term electric load forecasting.
typical_sota_score: 1–5% MAPE (depending on aggregation level and dataset)
reputation: Serves as a common, simple baseline in short-term load forecasting literature but is not state-of-the-art; used primarily for comparison against more complex models.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; simple linear baseline that can be outperformed by models that capture seasonality and nonlinearity; sensitivity to exogenous features and regime shifts; useful as a sanity-check baseline rather than a production solution.
